required_update_lifecycle: DISCOVER current state from architecture truth, files, containers, image hashes, and receipts.
CREATE patch plan with affected files, containers, ports, models, credentials, and user-facing behavior.
REQUEST approval for external, destructive, device, publishing, email, phone, financial, or customer-impacting changes.
APPLY changes only to declared scope.
RESTART only affected containers when possible.
VALIDATE health endpoints, compile checks, behavior checks, and truth endpoints.

update_scopes.regional: A connected subsystem such as creative production, business providers, device operators, user interfaces, or model lanes.
update_scopes.lane: One container/runtime lane such as Telegram, voice, vision, browser, desktop, phone, email, calendar, document, or creative.
update_scopes.laser: One file, one setting, one prompt, one visual style, one endpoint, one phrase, or one small behavior.
update_scopes.model: Switching or upgrading LLM, TTS, STT, vision, embedding, image, or local model provider.
update_scopes.governance: Standards, permissions, truth gate, approval policy, capability claims, audit requirements, or rollback rules.
update_scopes.system: Full ecosystem update involving many lanes, shared manifests, routing, standards, or distribution packages.
